class.name: DiffResult
class.brief_description: Holds a computed diff and can dispatch it as update ops.
class.description: DiffResult is produced by [method DiffUtil.calculate_diff]. It maps old/new positions and dispatches the minimal update script (insert / remove / move / change) to a [b]ListUpdateCallback[/b] via [method dispatch_updates_to].

method.name: convert_new_position_to_old
method.description: Maps a new-list index to the old-list index (-1 when the item is new).

method.name: convert_old_position_to_new
method.description: Maps an old-list index to the new-list index (-1 when the item no longer exists).

method.name: dispatch_updates_to
method.description: Dispatches the diff as incremental updates to the given [b]ListUpdateCallback[/b] (batching adjacent events).
